limitations: All aircraft/camera/sensor profiles are provisional, without measured physical agreement.
Synthetic odometry is generated from physics truth; image-derived VIO/SLAM is not implemented.
Range sensor uses conservative vertical columns; rolling shutter/exposure are first-order rotational approximations.
Reconstruction/calibration validation uses synthetic fixtures; no real-room capture or flight log was provided.
Native multi-profile comparisons are sequential; dashboard fleet remains kinematic and only pins hardware metadata.
Actual 8 GiB hardware and simultaneous native aircraft are untested.
The full challenge failed acceptance. Corrective reruns are development diagnostics, not replacement scores.
